duplicate_inverse_selection.finding: Across120 original wrapper/dispatcher cases, inverse notification selects the first wire matching endpoint persistent IDs, property, ordinal and flags bit0. An older exact duplicate or a duplicate differing only in flags bit16 is selected before the new wire; property, ordinal or flags bit0 mismatches select the new wire. Creation itself appends a fresh record in every case.
limits: Host supplies packet bounds/eventID and resolved optional inputs; original wrapper constructs header/cursor descriptor and executes dispatcher, then locates matching wire for inverse notification. History router is an explicit observation probe confirming inverse event fdf5 and selected first matching wire pointer; higher-level replay reader and undo/redo lifecycle remain unverified.
Valid acyclic resolver fixtures; no concurrency or gameplay.

mixed_wire_streams.finding: Original range reader, packet wrapper and dispatcher execute creation in pass2 before removal in pass3, even when removal precedes creation in input bytes. Input order is retained within these event groups. Creation appends new slots; removal tombstones first live match without decrementing count; these streams do not execute recreation after removal because the pass order groups creation first. Repeated missing removals are no-ops. Full world/owner and packet guards checked.
limits: Controlled allocation/free/TLS; prepared valid world and manually encoded packets. History output disabled, player255.
Finite wire-only streams, not full user undo/redo, malformed/dependency-cycle/concurrency/gameplay proof.
